data.long_meaning: Sharali is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that means 'Shining One'. The name Sharali carries the meaning “Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Sharali usually hope their child will grow to embody shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
